newsitem.title: UK: Natwest jumps four pct on new bid rumours.
newsitem.headline: Natwest jumps four pct on new bid rumours.

text.p: Shares in National Westminster Bank hit a record high in heavy volume on Tuesday on more market talk of an imminent takeover bid, traders said.
By 1011 GMT, Natwest was up 34-1/2p at 842p after touching 855p.
Dealers said market talk of a possible bidder for NatWest focused on Barclays Plc as well as on German bank Commerzbank AG.
"They're just rumours," said one trader. "It's just the same old story coming from the same old people."
On Monday Britain's Takeover Panel rejected a call by NatWest for Barclays to clarify its position on whether it was plotting a takeover bid.
Buffeted by a sharp rebound in the FTSE, Barclays shares were up 25p at 12.17 stg.
